title: Newgrange - Ruins Structure ✅
description: Newgrange is an ancient monument in a Minecraft vanilla-friendly style, inspired by Ireland’s prehistoric passage tomb, featuring a great circular mound, hidden chambers, and mysterious stone carvings.
body:
![Newgrange aerial](https://i.imgur.com/hgyFfun.jpeg)

Step into prehistory and uncover the ancient monument of Newgrange with the **Newgrange Mod**! This vanilla-friendly mod brings **Ireland’s iconic passage tomb** into Minecraft, appearing as monumental earth mounds in plains and river biomes. Each site captures the mystery of the original monument—vast circular mounds, hidden stone-lined passages, and chambers aligned with the rising sun—filling your world with **history, exploration, puzzles, and secret treasures**.

![Newgrange front](https://i.imgur.com/cqwgg1y.jpeg)

Perfect for players who enjoy **exploration, world-building, and discovering landmarks with cultural and historical inspiration**, the Newgrange monument serves as a unique point of interest to enrich your Minecraft adventures. Wander through grass-covered mounds, explore stone-carved passageways and hidden chambers, and let your imagination journey into the mysteries of an ancient tomb aligned with the rising sun.

![Newgrange inside](https://i.imgur.com/GpA4Gbb.jpeg)

Whether you're a **solo explorer or playing on a multiplayer server**, these ruins add **atmospheric depth, realism, and storytelling** potential to your world. Newgrange is more than a monument—it’s an invitation to uncover the mysteries of ancient Ireland and its prehistoric builders, while enhancing the rolling plains and river valleys of your Minecraft landscapes.
